changes: 9.6.1, after an independent review: the "Šodien marked" idea is its own Proposal line in the Agreed rules; the two "Rādīt visus rezultātus" drawings are labelled Proposal A (recommended) and Proposal B; small wording fixes (search chips on phones, the place list, part R7).

9.6, your decisions of 13 October on the filter. Line 1 is always one line: "Kur", "Tēma", on Pasākumi the date choices, the switch. Each button shows its choice ("Jelgava", "Jelgava +1", "Sports un fitness"), has a maximum width, cuts a long name with "…" and clears with a small ×.
The separate chosen line is gone everywhere; "Notīrīt visu" appears on the filter line only when two or more things are chosen.

Line 2, once a Tēma is chosen: the "Veids" chips on one line, the chosen first (tinted, with ×), then "+3" for the rest, which opens the Veids list ("Meklēt veidu"). "Veids" replaces "Apakškategorija" everywhere.

No "Rīt" on the filter line or in the calendar. Proposal: "Šodien" shows as chosen while the list shows today. Phones: the switch keeps its own line; Kur, Tēma and the date button now fit on one line under it (your note was on the phone drawing).
The day strip: the month in the middle, ‹ and › at the ends move the shown week; no "Šodien" link there.

"Rādīt visus rezultātus": two ways drawn, desktop and phone, recommended first (A, discovery with the search word as a chip and the matching themes and types above the list; B, a results page). It is Still open, question 1; the old question 1 (the compact filter area) is settled.
After "Sazināties": the form closes and a short toast says "Ziņa nosūtīta"; no second dialog, no "Atvērt sarunu".

Event rows have their short description again (muted, one line, "…"), in every copy. On the group page they are the same rows, only without the group line; the next event on Informācija moved out of the narrow side column.
A join request gets "Atbildēt" next to Noraidīt and Apstiprināt; it opens the conversation.
Checked at 375, 1280, 1600 and 1920 px, light and dark: nothing overlaps, no line wraps or runs over, only the intended "…" cuts.

9.5, after an independent review. Every overlap you marked was in a phone drawing: the filter buttons and the Grupas | Pasākumi switch shared one 300 px line, so the second button was cut at the switch. 9.4 faded it out, which still looked like a half-drawn button.
Now, on phones, the switch has a full-width line of its own and the filter buttons wrap below it; the chosen line and the search chips wrap too. Nothing scrolls sideways, is cut or faded.
The phone search drawing is marked as my suggestion; "Izveidot grupu" staying in the phone profile menu (next to the bottom bar's +) is marked as my suggestion too.

9.4, your notes of 13 October. The + leaves the header: on phones it sits in the middle of the bottom bar (Atklāt, Grupas, +, Ziņas, Es); on desktop "Izveidot grupu" is a line in the profile menu. Every header, bottom bar and profile menu follows.

Search: the bar is a plain field; a tap or click opens the search at once. At its top, chips: the place (the place list, set from the page's filter) and the matching categories, the same chips as elsewhere. A phone drawing is added.
Option B under "More compact" is withdrawn: it relied on the place in the search bar.

The overlaps are fixed at the root: on phones the filter row scrolls sideways, and a chip that didn't fit was cut off hard at the Grupas | Pasākumi switch. The one scroller (filter row, chosen line, search chips) now fades it out before the edge.
Checked at 375, 1280, 1440, 1600, 1680 and 1920 px, light and dark: no chip or filter overlaps another, no text overflows its chip.

The filter row is "Liked, awaiting approval": the sub-category appears only once a category is chosen (the drop-down drawings now show the chosen category too); Šodien, Rīt, Šonedēļ, Nedēļas nogalē and the range always sit on one line, also in the calendar.
The day strip has no arrows (a day is tapped directly); the calendar's month arrows sit right next to the month's name; "Rādīt nākamo nedēļu" is a plain text link.
"Citur" instead of "Citur Latvijā" everywhere. The place list, the sub-category list, the calendar, the group cards and the toggle are tagged as liked.
The note index lists your 25 open notes and where each is answered.

9.3, after an independent review: Still open has 18 questions. Where the Handbook or this page already decides (short messages, loading and error pages, text in another language, the cards / list switch, repeating events), the answer is in the comparison tables.
Reporting an event joined question 7. Question 15 ("are you sure?") now follows the Handbook: deleting for good always gets our own dialog; only steps that can be undone are open.
Questions 8 and 9 start with the recommended answer in one line. Case 4 (sign-ups closed) is no longer in the recommended words.

Compared with the live app: details the first version had dropped are back (the live words for joining an event, 15-minute times, sorting members by role, the two live words for a private group, Google and GitHub sign-in, and more).
The event page drawing for a signed-in non-member is now seen by Pēteris, not Ilze, who is a member of Vēja zirdžiņš elsewhere on the page.

Your answers of 13 October in the Agreed rules: the redesign ships in twelve parts, one by one; the language switch "LV ▾" stays in the header on every page; a slim footer on discovery and reading pages; screens not drawn follow the rules on this page.

Also from 13 October: an event's place is a required city plus a free address ("Tiešsaistē" for online); faces of who is going only for signed-in viewers; "Atsaukt pieteikumu"; no "Mani pasākumi" tab; social links at the end of Informācija.
